messages:
jonathan_rerank: Heads up - after enabling hybrid-quant (int4 backbone + int8 head) on ranker-v4 canary we see ~3.5% MRR drop on the recent_week holdout. NDCG mostly flat. Anyone else seeing this?

maria_ml: saw it in the dashboard this morning. concentrated on tail queries (low candidate diversity).

eli_infra: was this with the candidate-ordering change we rolled last week? we added a small shuffle for even distribution.

sophia_eval: good call - can repro quickly with preserve-order flag. Quick command: ```./tools/rerank_eval --model=ranker-v4-quant --holdout=recent_week --seed=42 --preserve-order```

jonathan_rerank: thanks. logs also show different tie-breaking on top scores between float and quant path, maybe due to tiny score perturbations. attaching snippet of pairwise diffs:
```
--- before (float32)
q123 candA 0.842
q123 candB 0.840
--- after (hybrid-quant)
q123 candB 0.841
q123 candA 0.840
```

maria_ml: also remember we switched head calibration from global-scale to per-layer scale in the canary - that can compress top gaps. NDCG@10 actually up 0.1% but head@1 MRR down.

eli_infra: I'll rollback the candidate-shuffle on staging and re-run the batch.

sophia_eval: did a quick run: when shuffle=on delta ~3.4% MRR drop; shuffle=off delta shrinks to ~0.4%. looks correlated.

jonathan_rerank: plan: 1) run vanity repro with preserved ordering + pinned quant config; 2) run cross-seed x5; 3) produce candidate-level diffs for top-10 per query and surface patterns. who can take #3?

maria_ml: I'll take diffs. will check near-duplicate collapse and tokenization parity (we had small tokenizer tweak last month).

eli_infra: deploy-bot: rolling back candidate-shuffle on staging now.

deploy-bot: rollback candidate-shuffle to staging succeeded at 2026-03-23T10:05:27Z

sophia_eval: small note: hyperbatch/latency knobs change pad distribution; int4 kernel heuristics are sensitive to pad ratios - could amplify tiny score changes into ranking flips. worth checking batching config too.

jonathan_rerank: :thumbsup: if repro holds we'll pin quant config + preserve-order in canary and open a PR to revert shuffle in prod until validated. target 48h.

maria_ml: uploading quick artifact with diffs: https://internal/redwood/artifacts/rr-v4-quant-holdout-1797 (contains CSV of top-10 before/after + seed info)

eli_infra: I'll also kick off a multi-seed run on staging with shuffle toggled and attach logs.

sophia_eval: FYI I included the eval flags used in my run in case folks want to reproduce exactly: ```--batch-size=64 --pad-policy=left --hyperbatch=on --quant-profile=hybrid_int4_int8_v2```

jonathan_rerank: thanks all - let's sync in the rerank standup if we see consistent signal. if anyone spots something surprising in diffs ping me directly.
